presentation: A 44-year-old man with a history of prediabetes and hyperlipidemia presents with exertional chest pain in the upper left chest and dyspnea associated with exercise. His ASCVD risk score is 1.2% and his EKG shows 1st degree AV block. He had a negative stress test. His family history is notable for early-onset CAD, as his father had an MI at age 55. What would be the next step in evaluating for cardiac causes for this patient's chest pain?
